hero.title: Licensed online consultations tailored to where you live
hero.description: Secure video and messaging-based care across Europe.

countryHero.subtitle: Choose a service, select an open time, and speak with licensed clinicians registered with national medical councils across Europe.

team.headline: The clinician you choose is
team.body: Every consultation is with someone licensed where you are. No call centres, no rota of strangers — the doctor on screen is the doctor on the profile.

howItWorks.subtitle: From landing on the page to a confirmed appointment — the path through service, clinician, time, and patient details.
howItWorks.step1Body: We connect you with doctors registered in your country — so referrals, certificates, and follow-ups all work locally.
howItWorks.step2Body: Browse general, specialist, and home-test services. Filter by language, urgency, or price.
howItWorks.step3Body: Join the consultation from any device. Receive notes or next steps when clinically appropriate after the appointment.

finalCta.body: Browse licensed doctors registered with national medical councils across Europe, then choose an open appointment time where availability is shown.

statsBand.headline: Built for people who shouldn't have to
statsBand.body: Access licensed clinicians through open appointment slots, clear profiles, and service-specific booking steps.
statsBand.stat1Caption: Registered with their local medical council.
statsBand.stat3Caption: Open slots are shown from live doctor calendars.
